title: WUPHF.com
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, the office faces a power outage while discussing WUPHF.com, with characters debating investment decisions, company future, and humorous interactions. Dwight deals with a hay contest, and Ryan presents plans for WUPHF's growth amid discussions of potential sale and investment strategies.
